hints.title: Star Graph Structure
hints.text: A star graph consists of a center node and a subset of its direct neighbors.

hints.title: Neighbor Contribution Selection
hints.text: Only neighbors with strictly positive values increase the star sum. Negative values should be ignored.

hints.title: Selecting Top-k Neighbors
hints.text: For each node, sort or partition its positive neighbor values descending and sum at most k largest values.

hints.title: Star Sum Optimization Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting neighbor values per vertex bounded by overall edge count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subsets of edges per node causes exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory stores neighbor lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that negative neighbor values must be excluded and only top k positive values are needed.
